conceptual_origin: EL CAMPO DISTRIBUIDO DE TRAZAS — superposición + interferencia
task: paired A/B trace histories in native K with matched single-trace references and a common future probe

primary_hypotheses.H3_nonlinearity_localized_to_readout: synthetic_readout_nonadditivity - K_storage_error >0; one-sided sign-flip, >75% favorable seeds, bootstrap lower bound >0, mean difference >0.05

interpretation_rule.all_pass: multiple traces are stored in K approximately by linear superposition, while their joint operational effect is generated mainly by nonlinear readout/acoupling downstream of K
interpretation_rule.H1_pass_H3_fail: storage superposition is confirmed but operational interference is not

scope_warning: operational interference is a dynamical readout effect; not evidence of a physical field, adaptive value, phenomenology, or consciousness
